pages.text: $(l)$(6)The Ancient Art of Alchemy$()$(br2)Alchemy is the noble art of transformation, not just of the elements but of a great many other resources as well.$(br2)Also of refinement, getting more from the raw resources you find in the world.$(br2)Lastly of divination, finding said resources in the first$(br)  place.
The Hermetica contains everything the budding alchemist needs learn and hone their craft.
